data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mahkamah refers to the divine court or tribunal where justice is administered. It is believed that seeking justice in this court through duas and prayers can lead to peace and fulfillment in life. The name Mahkamah carries the meaning “Court, Tribunal” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahkamah usually hope their child will grow to embody court, tribunal and live with faith, good character and purpose.
